about: [O1 critic] the car up the kerb and along the pavement of Grand Ave at speed: into the lamps, bins, benches, posts. Does anything pass through the car (a prop's circle inside the car's box)? What does a hit do?

steps.eval: (() => { const R = window.__kr = { through: [], hits: [], n: 0 }; const tick = () => { const c = G.city.car; if (c) { R.n++; for (const o of G.stage.colliders.near(c.pos.x, c.pos.z, 4)) { if (o.r == null) continue; const l = c.local(new N.THREE.Vector3(o.cx ?? o.x, 0, o.cz ?? o.z), new N.THREE.Vector3()); if (Math.abs(l.x) < c.spec.halfL - 0.3 && Math.abs(l.z) < c.spec.halfW - 0.3) { const k = o.tag + '@' + (o.cx ?? o.x).toFixed(1) + ',' + (o.cz ?? o.z).toFixed(1); if (!R.through.includes(k)) R.through.push(k); } } } requestAnimationFrame(tick); }; requestAnimationFrame(tick); return 1; })()

JSON.stringify({v:+(G.city.car.speed*3.6).toFixed(0), pos:[+G.city.car.pos.x.toFixed(1),+G.city.car.pos.z.toFixed(1)], cr:G.city.car.stats.crashes, sc:G.city.car.stats.scrapes, thr:window.__kr.through, n:window.__kr.n, props: G.stage.colliders.near(G.city.car.pos.x, G.city.car.pos.z, 30).filter(o=>o.r!=null).map(o=>o.tag).join(',')})
